name: match_to_datetime
reason: matchToDatetime mirrors :65-92 (date-only return, default seconds, ljust micros, offset/Z/local, then the datetime range checks) and DatetimeSpec pins every token RE_DATETIME accepts: the date or datetime value with truncated microseconds when the date exists, and 'Invalid date or datetime' at the token otherwise.

name: cached_tz
reason: cachedTz mirrors :100-106 and DatetimeSpec pins the signed offset sign*(60*HH+MM) minutes for every +HH:MM/-HH:MM the regex allows; the lru_cache only memoizes and timezone(timedelta(0)) is the UTC singleton (Modules/_datetimemodule.c:1465-1466), so minutes are a fair representation.

name: match_to_localtime
reason: matchToLocaltime mirrors :110-113 and DatetimeSpec pins every HH:MM[:SS[.frac]] token to datetime.time with seconds defaulting to 0 and truncated, zero-padded microseconds.

name: match_to_number
reason: matchToNumber mirrors :117-119 and NumberSpec pins both branches for every TOML number token: parse_float called on exactly the token text (with its exception or the dict/list ValueError), int(s, 0) values for decimal and prefixed integers, and the int_max_str_digits ValueError for decimals only (Objects/longobject.c:3025-3033; the limit as a parameter is a fair scope).
